statement: Linux hid-input maps HID Button usage n from 1 through 16 under a Game Pad application to BTN_GAMEPAD + (n-1), and higher buttons to BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY offsets. Because generic HID Button usage positions are ordinal, they do not automatically equal xpad's legacy BTN_X/BTN_Y codes; explicit descriptor usage list matters for X/Y, as EXP-0016 demonstrated.
